violation_type.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

finding_variants.text: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.
The emergency preparedness plan was not complete.

The emergency preparedness plan was reviewed during inspection.   How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter,  who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments needs to be added to the plan, as well  as how staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released, and how children will be reunified with parents after  evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted needs to be added to the plan.
A written emergency prepardeness plan is needed.
The operation's emergency preparedness plan is incomplete and missing specific information regarding the operations children under 24 months relocation plan and the operations relocation site.
The operation did not have the required information in the emergency preparedness plan.
